text:
Sana (Marketing Ops): Heads up — a handful of inbound leads are sitting in HubSpot "Needs Review" for >30m and not flowing into Salesforce. Saw a spike at ~1716000000. Anyone else?
Tiago (RevOps): sending quick check — any recent workflow changes or enrichment failures?
Sana (Marketing Ops): we rolled a small HS workflow tweak yesterday to add a inferred_region field, but nothing else. Enrichment lambda seems healthy.
Liam (Sales Eng): I saw a few webhook retries in our listener logs earlier, 502 from the SF side. Might be transient.
Tiago (RevOps): digging into the router logs now. Quick reproducer I ran:
```
# curl payload we send from HS -> router
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/lead -d '{"hs_contact_id":"12345","status":"new","enrichment":{}}'
```
Tiago (RevOps): router shows `drop_if_unmapped=true` for contacts without owner_mapping; we had a mapping job error at 1715999900 that cleared but left a stale cache entry.
Anjali (Growth): is that why round-robin didn't assign? some leads stayed unowned?
Tiago (RevOps): yes. The round-robin assignment runs after enrichment + mapping. If mapping returns null we intentionally put them in Needs Review. The bug was the cache TTL was negative after the deploy, so the mapping service returned 503 for a 2m window.
Sana (Marketing Ops): ok — do we have a patch or mitigation we can push fast? Some MQLs are piling up.
Tiago (RevOps): mitigation plan: 1) invalidate mapping cache cluster-wide, 2) temporarily disable drop_if_unmapped in router config so leads route to fallback queue, 3) kick a one-off job to backfill unowned leads into RR queue. I can run 1+2 in the next 10m.
Liam (Sales Eng): +1 for fallback queue — we can have SDR team triage while mapping is fixed. Can you also add a flag to avoid reprocessing if enrichment timestamp older than 1h? to avoid thundering backups.
Tiago (RevOps): good call. will set a processing gate `enrichment_ts >= now() - 3600`.
deploy-bot: routing-service v2.14.3 restart scheduled by Tiago at 1716000200 (ETA 90s).
Tiago (RevOps): restarted mapping-worker and invalidated cache at 1716000220. I also flipped `drop_if_unmapped=false` in router config and reloaded.
Anjali (Growth): can we surface a single query for marketing to see which leads were backfilled?
Tiago (RevOps): yes — running SQL to capture affected hs_contact_ids: `SELECT hs_id FROM lead_events WHERE status='Needs Review' AND created_at BETWEEN to_timestamp(1715999900) AND to_timestamp(1716000300);` will paste results in a sec.
Sana (Marketing Ops): thanks. Once backfill runs can we notify the SDR channel and the owner column in the HS view?
Tiago (RevOps): will push a small patch to the HubSpot view mapping so owner shows fallback_pool when unassigned. Backfill job queued — estimated completion 3m.
Liam (Sales Eng): SDRs notified. Also logging an action item: add a canary that checks mapping cache health and alerts at 5% unmapped rate over 2m.
Sana (Marketing Ops): solid. postmortem later, but immediate win — thanks team. :thumbsup:
Anjali (Growth): FYI I'll block the affected IDs from running nurture emails until ownership confirmed.
Tiago (RevOps): backfill finished at 1716000400, 28 leads moved to fallback queue and 19 got direct RR owners after mapping cache repopulated.
Sana (Marketing Ops): perfect. closing the immediate ticket. Please add the canary and a runbook step for toggling `drop_if_unmapped`.
Tiago (RevOps): will follow up with a PR for the canary and a short runbook note.
Liam (Sales Eng): leaving a comment in the SDR handbook about manual triage steps.
Sana (Marketing Ops): thanks all — great teamwork.
